snippet.title: Volgarr the Viking - Sega Dreamcast - North American Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Völgarr The Viking for Sega Dreamcast

Remember when games were tough? Return to the Golden Age of arcades with an all-NEW hardcore action experience that pulls no punches! Völgarr the Viking possesses all the hallmarks of the true classics – simple controls, high challenge, and meticulous design – combined with hand-made pixel animation, an epic soundtrack, and buckets of blood. Flex your gaming muscles and step into the arena with Völgarr the Viking. We dare you.

FEATURES:
Classic hardcore arcade action!
Seven worlds to explore across 30+ maps
40+ unique traps and enemies, including screen-filling bosses
Thousands of frames of handcrafted pixel animation
Orchestrated soundtrack
Meticulous control design with full customization
Multiple paths through the game and multiple endings
Supports HDMI & VGA Cables
REGION FREE

https://videogamesnewyork.com/volgarr-the-viking-sega-dreamcast/
